input.quote: Garman hereby grants to Sparkling, for the use of Sparkling and affiliated companies of Sparkling operating at Authorized Locations, a non-transferable and non-exclusive licence to use: (i) the Software, safely in executable object code format, at each AS400 at each of the Authorized Locations; and (ii) the Documentation.
input.rationale: We reviewed the licence grant (§2), the restrictions on Sparkling's use (§3), maintenance and support (§10, including the Software Repair Service provisions) and fees (§11), and searched the whole agreement for "exclusive", "sole", "requirements", "third part" and "compet". The only uses of "exclusive" are (i) the non-exclusive licence grant to Sparkling in §2, (ii) the perpetual non-exclusive escrow-code licence to Sparkling (p0115), (iii) the exclusive-remedy provision in §15 and (iv) non-exclusive jurisdiction in the governing law clause — none of which is an exclusive-dealing or sole-supplier commitment. Section 3 imposes only software-use restrictions and contains no bar on procuring competing products or services from third parties, and nothing obliges Sparkling to source maintenance, improvements or future modules solely from Garman. Sparkling therefore retains full freedom to buy from other suppliers, which matches the preferred position; no redline is required (adding an affirmative non-exclusivity statement would be an unnecessary edit).
